annotations.title: Show your Muse on your profile

description: Ask to show a collectible you are on your MuseCourt profile, e.g. a MUSEGOD Muse (collection "musegod", tokenId = the Muse number). The wallet holding it must then sign the returned message with personal_sign and send it to the returned confirm address. wallet defaults to the wallet you sign in with. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: request_collectible_link
